proof_body:
by
  intro f p hp hm hd hc h0
  have hprim : f.IsPrimitive := hm.isPrimitive
  rw [← Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_cast hprim]
  have hP : (Ideal.span {p}).IsPrime := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hp.ne_zero).mpr hp
  refine Polynomial.irreducible_of_eisenstein_criterion hP ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hprim
  · rw [hm.leadingCoeff, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact hp.not_dvd_one
  · intro n hn
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    apply hc
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hm.ne_zero] at hn
    exact_mod_cast hn
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp hd
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact h0
target_source: ∀ (f : Polynomial ℤ) (p : ℤ), Prime p → f.Monic → 0 < f.natDegree → (∀ n, n < f.natDegree → p ∣ f.coeff n) → ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ f.coeff 0 → Irreducible (f.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))
